pairs.why: Almost identical; B's body reads very slightly smoother and softer, like the real cards' clean plastic, but the difference is barely visible.
Same model, lighting and finish in both; no difference that matters for matching the real cards.
B's surfaces look a touch cleaner and less textured, but the two are nearly the same.
B has slightly calmer highlights and a smoother body that are closer to the real cards' soft finish; A's bulb glow and contact shadow are a bit stronger.
I can't see a real difference in rendering, shape or color between them.

B's glowing bulb and purple-leaning ring background are closer to the real cards; A's flat, matte bulb looks slightly unfinished.
Both are effectively the same render; any difference is too small to pick between them.
